description: V2 code review fixes: (1) Skip push notification on re-like/re-save (when findOneAndUpdate returns existing record), (2) Change FlatList windowSize from 5 to 7 for better scroll buffer on lower-end devices.
steps: Step 1: In backend notification.service.js, add isNewNotification flag. Set it to false when existing is truthy, true otherwise. Only send push when isNewNotification is true.
Step 2: In mobile HomeScreen.tsx, change windowSize from 5 to 7.
acceptance_criteria: Push notification is NOT sent when findOneAndUpdate returns an existing record (re-like/re-save)
Push notification IS sent for newly created notifications
Mobile TypeScript compiles (35 pre-existing errors expected, no new ones)
